research_task.title: Compile the preserved real-axis probes offline

summary: A repeated and independently challenged offline audit cannot reach the eta declaration question because the permitted directory contains no pinned Lean/Mathlib project or dependency cache, and Lean, Lake, and Elan do not resolve.

value_assessment.novelty: This independently reproduces the linked parent's pre-build obstruction in the new attempt. It adds a digest-identified audit, reconstructed candidate probes, and a staged successor protocol, but does not strengthen the paper-level real-axis result.
value_assessment.evidence: Two consecutive audit executions returned identical structured output, and an independent filesystem and executable-lookup check agreed: all compiler and project-cache prerequisites were absent and offline build readiness was false even though reconstructed source candidates were present.
value_assessment.falsifier: A complete pinned project and local dependency cache together with a successful offline minimal zeta-name elaboration would overturn the claimed pre-build obstruction.

claims.statement: Within this attempt's permitted directory and current application environment, the requested fixed-revision Lean replay is impossible before declaration lookup: there is no pinned Lean/Mathlib project or local dependency cache, and Lean, Lake, and Elan do not resolve.
claims.evidence_summary: Two byte-identical executions of a digest-identified audit and a final check using independent filesystem and executable-lookup mechanisms found three missing applications, the absent toolchain pin, absent Lake project and manifest, and absent local dependency cache; candidate source files alone did not change readiness.
claims.verification_method: Repeat the audit and independently inventory files and applications without network access; the claim fails if a complete pinned project and usable offline compiler are found.

limitations: No Lean source was compiled, so this is a pre-build observation rather than a compiler rejection.
The probe sources are reconstructions rather than recovered parent artifacts and remain uncompiled.
A clean textual scan for unfinished-proof and local-axiom patterns is not compilation or an imported-axiom audit.
Concrete zeta naming and the first unavailable eta-related declaration remain undetermined without a fixed Mathlib revision.
The negative environment result is scoped to this permitted directory and current application environment.
No conclusion about the Riemann Hypothesis is asserted.
failed_approaches: The preferred fast file indexer could not start under the sandbox, so native read-only inventories were used.
The intended cached-project compilation could not start because all required project and toolchain prerequisites are absent.
next_actions: Deliver the preserved sources and complete immutable offline Lean/Mathlib dependency closure, then execute staged zeta and eta declaration probes.

proposed_tasks.title: Replay staged zeta and eta probes in a delivered offline cache
proposed_tasks.objective: Compile the generic kernel and concrete zeta probe under an immutable Lean/Mathlib revision, then test eta definition, nonzeroness, and continued identity declarations sequentially.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The present review is blocked before declaration lookup because neither the project nor compiler is supplied.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: Two identical offline builds with source digests, toolchain and revision identifiers, verified concrete zeta naming, the first failing eta probe or a complete theorem, and printed declaration dependencies and axioms.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: A minimal compiler transcript that accepts the zeta name and isolates the first unavailable eta definition, nonzeroness theorem, or continued identity in the fixed revision.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Rebuild twice from the delivered immutable cache and compare compiler output, source digests, declaration prints, and axiom reports.
